newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah steady in narrow-range trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah steady in narrow-range trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was steady against the dollar in narrow-range trading on Friday.

Dealers said trading was slow, with some dollar selling from Singapore players seen emerging at the 2,434.50 level, driving the rupiah higher to 2,432.75/33.50 at 0300 GMT from an open of 2,434.5/35.5.
One local bank dealer said the dollar appeared to be well supported at the 2,432.0 level on domestic support following relatively ample money supply in the morning.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were traded at 2,432.40/33.10 and 2,432.50/32.75, respectively.
Dealers said the overall trend suggested operators were tending to go long on dollars because of underlying caution due to the ongoing campaign for the May 29 general elections.
"My view is the dollar may move to the right further. I haven't seen the flow yet for this morning because of a quiet market," one dealer in Singapore said.
The dealer said local players had no reason to sell dollars as liquidity remained ample and they remained cautious because of the election campaign.
"I will buy on dips in both spot and forwards," he said.
Dealers said the forward market seemed to have been neglected in the past few days, suggesting speculation was on the increase.
"It's easier to get in and out from the market if you only get involved in the spot market," the Singapore dealer said.
"I hardly get any call in forwards," he added.
Overnight swap was at 0.9/1.0 and tom/next at 0.33/0.35.
One-month swaps were at 12.5/13.0, two at 25.00/25.75, three at 37.0/37.5 and six at 74.5/75.5 points.
Bank Indonesia kept its intervention band at 2,407/2,599 and the conversion band at 2,409/2,457 on Thursday.
